# Long-term reanalysis-based energy yield of the Gulf of Saros offshore wind candidate area, Türkiye: sensitivity to reference period, grid node and wind data source

## Abstract

Türkiye published four candidate areas for offshore wind in May 2026. For the
Gulf of Saros area, this study asks what a public reanalysis indicates about
the long-term energy yield, and how sensitive the answer is to choices that
are often left implicit. Hourly ERA5 wind speeds for 1994–2024 at the grid
node nearest the candidate polygon were extrapolated to a hub height of 105 m
and converted hour by hour with a reference 9.5 MW power curve and assumed
losses. The net specific yield is 2.354 GWh MW⁻¹ yr⁻¹, at a net capacity
factor of 26.85 %. The 90 % sampling interval of the 31-year mean is
2.300–2.407 GWh MW⁻¹ yr⁻¹. Three sensitivity experiments move the result by
more than this interval. The most recent 11 years alone give a yield 3.1 %
higher, and they form the highest of all 11-year windows in the record. The
two neighbouring ERA5 nodes give +6.7 % and −8.5 %; the node used is a mixed
land–sea cell outside the polygon. The Global Wind Atlas indicates a mean wind
speed about 12 % higher than ERA5 for matched periods. This disagreement
cannot be resolved from model data, because the atlas is itself driven by
ERA5. The categories differ in kind and are reported separately; they are not
combined into one uncertainty interval. A first-order screening shows water
depths below 62 m throughout the polygon and an overlap of about 14 % with a
Special Environmental Protection Area. No result is validated against offshore
measurements. For a narrow coastal area such as this one, the reference
period, the grid cell and the wind product should be reported and tested, and
measurements inside the polygon are the step that would most improve knowledge
of the resource.

**Keywords:** offshore wind energy; ERA5 reanalysis; energy yield; capacity
factor; spatial representativeness; reference period; sensitivity analysis;
Global Wind Atlas; Gulf of Saros; Türkiye
